reviews.text: I came into the clinic because I saw an ad on the internet and my sister has been to this clinic. Dr. Klinger and staff were very kind and informative about my little pup's situation and did not try and tell me or sell me things that she did not need. I really appreciated their honesty, kindness  & care.🥰🐕‍🦺

Thank you to the Drs, technicians, and staff! We've been bringing our kittens here for their vaccines over the last month or so, and then recently had an emergency scare that they fit us in for. Everyone is so kind, patient and welcoming. They don't try to upsell you or put your pet through unnecessary tests/treatments. Very grateful we have a trusted vet to take care of our babies!
We've trusted our cats' care to Mission Valley Pet Clinic for decades. They always do a great job, both the staff and the veterinarians.

I have now entrusted three of my pets to this clinic, and I cannot say enough good things about the care, compassion, and professionalism of the entire team.

Most recently, they helped me through the passing of my 17-year-old cat with incredible kindness, respect, and dignity. During one of the most difficult moments a pet owner can face, the staff made sure both my cat and my family were treated with genuine compassion. I will always be grateful for the comfort and support they provided.

Sarah has been amazing every step of the way. She is knowledgeable, caring, and always willing to take the time to answer questions and help us make informed decisions about our pets' care. Dr. Klinger is wonderful and consistently provides thoughtful, thorough care that gives us confidence that our pets are in the best hands.

I heard Melissa is leaving and I want to make sure it is known how appreciated she was! People like Melissa are a huge part of what makes this clinic so special. Her kindness, warmth, and dedication have left a lasting impression on so many families, and she will truly be missed.

We hope the clinic continues to recognize and value the people who make this level of care possible. They are the reason clients like us keep coming back. Thank you to everyone at the clinic for the exceptional care you provide every day. ❤️🐾

I’m giving this place one star because they misplaced my dog’s fecal sample. I had to call to find out why I never received the results. The young lady provided great customer service, but I was disappointed with the fill-in veterinarian’s demeanor and felt the examination was not thorough. The “free exam for new patients” promotion was also misleading because I wasn’t aware it only applied to one dog. Overall, I was disappointed with my experience and will not be returning.
Took my bulldog in for her yearly checkup.  Everyone was wondering as always.

This review is long overdue. My experiences with management have been extremely disappointing, and unfortunately, my interactions with the technician, Melissa, have been just as frustrating. She has consistently come across as rude, dismissive, and unprofessional.
Every interaction with her has been incredibly unpleasant. She speaks to people in a condescending manner, as though they are ignorant, and gives off an attitude that she is above everyone else. The way she communicates with customers is unacceptable and has made each experience feel unnecessarily difficult and stressful.

Management should take these concerns seriously and address the way customers are being treated. No one should leave an establishment feeling disrespected or belittled.
Staff is amazing. Kind, caring, knowledgeable, friendly. I feel both my kitty and I are receiving the best care ever!
I used boarding services for my 2 dogs. I have trusted their facility with all of my animals.throughout the years. I feel confident they are receiving quality care.

DO NOT BRING YOUR PET HERE!!!! Besides being ridiculously over-communicative (you will receive a constant barrage of emails alerting of such pressing matters as closing early for a staff meeting), they insist on PREDATORY POLICIES that do not serve the client and put the health of pets at risk. THEY WILL NOT RELEASE YOUR PRESCRIPTION to you to block you from shopping for better prices and more convenience online (i.e. Chewy). I brought my dog in for a wellness exam, specifically to renew a Credelio prescription, and assumed they would send it to me digitally as I was never offered one in person. I placed my order on Chewy and contacted their customer service to call MVPC to approve the prescription as they have done this several times in the past. Now, weeks later, MVPC will not approve the order with Chewy as they do not give digital versions available to 3rd parties! To review, I was not given a paper prescription at the in-person visit, and was further denied a digital version after the visit. The only solution is to order directly through them at a higher price! I repeat, DO NOT BRING YOUR PET HERE!!!!
Thank you for taking the time to rate us, Kelly! We are delighted that you had a great experience with Mission Valley Pet Clinic .
always a pleasant experience here

I was very stressed about bringing my senior cat in because of a horrific experience I had with a previous cat and a different vet. But the staff and vet I met here were all super friendly and so calm that it made it easy for my cat and I to relax into their care. They provided me with suggestions with future care that I really appreciated and we were out the door in under an hour. Would definitely recommend.
Best vet I've seen thus far
Excellent care. !
They were very patient with our new dog visit. And helped us get her health problems under control. They scheduled her spay and gastropexy for 2 weeks. Now we have two poodles to manage.
My cat was having some digestive issues and the staff was awesome! They did an exam and suggested some supplements that he should take, I will recommending this vet!
Very sweet staff, no matter how busy they are they are all very polite and very professional.

All the staff at Mission Valley Pet Clinic were amazing in caring for my spicy cat, Zombie. I am so grateful to have found them when Zom began to get sick. He had been turned away from an urgent care for being grumpy, so I was concerned about finding him regular care. Everyone at Mission Valley knew how to handle him effectively and humanely. Saying goodbye to Zom became unavoidable, but Dr Herrera did everything she could to diagnose and treat his condition, including keeping in contact with me as his illness progressed. Dr Klinger treated him for his initial respiratory infection, and was understanding and compassionate on the day we had to say goodbye. I was a mess, but she was very patient and empathetic. The staff were able to get him in quickly for his appointments, and remembered him when I would call. We were always brought to an exam room quickly, as they seemed to recognize that being around other patients made him anxious. Zom was my best friend, and grieving him has been incredibly difficult. But I am so thankful to have found Mission Valley to care for him during such a hard time. Everyone there truly cares about their patients and pet parents, and will do everything possible to help them.

Mission Valley Pet Clinic treats our 17 yr old cat with great care and tenderness. They listen very carefully and use our info to best treat our special kitty. She is having some issues, but with their care she will continue to be healthy and happy, getting lots of rubs!
Mission Valley Pet Clinic is wonderful!! Friendly, professional, to the point!! They took great care of our 12 year old lab and were extremely reasonable! Highly recommend!!
Would never take my pet anywhere else.  Everyone here is amazing,  been going here for over 20 years and they are always great.
Friendly staff. Great first visit and looking forward to them assisting me with my aging pet soon. Thanks
Your feedback is highly appreciated, Roashelle. Thank you so much for the review!

Wow, I am so happy to have found MVPC and Dr. Herrera!! My sweet little kitty. Mousey, was just looking very skinny to me. She is a very petite cat but I was worried about her. From the second I walked in the door to the end of the appointment, I was treated by the kindest staff and they were super caring and knowledgeable. Dr Herrera was amazing! She immediately put me at ease. There was no upselling of unnecessary tests or pushing any kind of products, nothing like that at all. I am so pleased with the care Mousey received!

I had a really positive experience at this vet office. The staff was kind, calm, and realistic about what actually needed to be done. I especially appreciated that the vet wasn’t pushy with unnecessary tests or treatments and focused on what made sense for my dog’s situation. I left feeling heard and reassured, which means a lot. Definitely grateful for their approach and care.
I can’t recommend this place enough, fantastic staff and top notch trustworthy care.

All of the staff is always friendly, informative. They are very caring to my dog in every visit. They call the next day to see how my dog is doing. If I have a question, they call back with the answer right away.

MV Pet Care has seen some personnel changes over the years but every vet and vet tech whom I've met there has provided my cats with good care.
Also, Pet care is not cheap. MV Pet Clinic had never tried to upsell me, and they always provide me a written estimate of charges before treatment.

Mission Valley Pet Clinic was 10/10. They were all so kind and very friendly. They made my dog feel comfortable from the moment we walked in. They explained everything and pricing before anything was done. They were able to get me in quickly to take care of my dog's dental. Could not recommend them more as a vet clinic and to get dental treatment for your animal.
I’m very pleased with the Doctors & Staff at Mission Valley Pet Clinic. They are all professional, kind and caring. I highly recommend them!
Excellent care!

The veterinarians, techs and office staff are all very professional and helpful. I have used Mission Valley Pet Clinic for three cats and two dogs over a span of 20 years. I have always had the very best care and professional responsiveness.
Hi, Lorraine. We appreciate the rating. So glad we could provide you with a positive experience at Mission Valley Pet Clinic!
The place is quite and welcoming.  They treated my Blu nice.  They are professional and treat their animals kindly witj respect.
Hi, Bt. Great to hear that you had a good experience at Mission Valley Pet Clinic. We really appreciate you taking the time to share!

I was pleasantly surprised at the cost of the visit.  It was significantly lower than other vets in the area.  They even gave me a complimentary first visit,  and I was able to stay with my dog during his treatment.  This was very helpful because I didn't have to listen to his cries of agony at being separated from me as he has really bad separation anxiety.  Finally, this vet did something no others have for my dog -they called me the next day to see how he was doing after his vaccinations.  Thanks! ❤️🥰

We love Mission Valley Pet clinic!! The staff are amazing and always welcoming!! The examination rooms are clean. The nurses and Doctors always do there best to find solutions to our cats health issues without running up the bill with unnecessary tests. and most of all they remember our cat's name!
Thank you so much for sharing your great experience with us, Ana !
Dr. Herrera and team always take great care of our pup.  They always provide options and are focused on best outcomes for your four legged family members.
Very positive— didn’t take a photo. Sorry!

This pet clinic is great. All the staff is very attentive and you can tell they genuinely care for the wellbeing of all animals. When I took my cat here, I appreciated that Dr. Ngo took the time to do a thorough examination and recommended only what was necessary. Very cost friendly. Will be going back for any further vet checkups!

We have been taking our dog to Mission Valley Pet Clinic for 9 years.  They are THE BEST.  The vets are so caring, knowledgeable and concerned about our furry friend.  The techs and office staff do their best to get us in and out efficiently and with great care.    We love MVPC!

We had been bringing our dog to this clinic for almost 2 years and we were wondering why our dog was always terrified. We just assumed it was how dogs might be around vets. It wasnt until one of the vets who had been taking care of our dog came in and immediately started making rude comments towards our type of dog with no actual negative interactions with her. She made rude comments towards my partner. Overall the people had been nice and the techs all were very kind other than one vet specifically. We have moved onto another vet and our dog had a much easier time.
Very professional! You can see that they really love animals and owners:) highly recommend ! Hi from Sam the brindle boxer :))
Thank you for taking the time to rate us, Marjorie! We are delighted that you had a great experience with Mission Valley Pet Clinic .
This was my first visit at this clinic.  O am so pleased that I had made the switch.  Looking forward to future visits and knowing my pet will have great care

I went to this veterinarian one time and I won’t be back right from the moment. I walked into the office. I got a very unfriendly vibe. My dog needed treatment so I That well, let’s just get this over with and I won’t come back. Nothing got resolved. They were so afraid of my dog they wouldn’t come near her. I never even saw the doctor so no I don’t recommend this place.
Your feedback is highly appreciated, Samantha. Thank you so much for the review!
Excellent people, excellent care for your fur babies.
Hi, Will. We appreciate the rating. So glad we could provide you with a positive experience at Mission Valley Pet Clinic!

I brought my cat Bo (who’s 6) to Mission Valley Pet Clinic and had a great experience. The entire team was pleasant, kind, and made the visit feel easy from start to finish. Bo got his yearly shots and a nail trim, and I also learned that he’s not actually overweight — just a bigger breed of kitty, which was honestly great news to hear.

I would absolutely trust this team with any of my furry friends and definitely recommend them.
These folks are amazing
Tech appointments for nail trimming, etc are a breeze.  The staff is always very helpful and pleasant.
Hi, Michael. Great to hear that you had a good experience at Mission Valley Pet Clinic. We really appreciate you taking the time to share!

I highly recommend Mission Valley Pet Clinic, they are very helpful, and friendly, the staff, the vets, they care and it's very easy to communicate with them. I'll be def coming back, I know they will take good care of my dog.
Our vet for 20 years and 5 dogs.  Amazing and personable.
Thank you so much for sharing your great experience with us, Lisa !
It was my cats 1st grown vet visit and she was very calm. So visit wqas quick and informative

I just have to sing the praises of MVPC. I think I’ve been going to them since 2017. I have taken both my dogs for regular check ups, vaccinations, teeth cleanings, and emergency visits over the years and while all experiences I’ve had have been high quality, I have a few cherished memories that let me know they really value the animals and their people. Through battling arthritis with Panchito (brown black shepherd mix) over the last couple of years and providing me the tools necessary to make hard decisions, MVPC has been there. They are very good with responding to queries through their pet app, working online prescriptions, and providing alternative resources when needed. While Panchito had to pass over the rainbow bridge, I know I’ll still happily bring his brother Cooper and get the same quality care as always.

MVPC sets the bar high and I truly believe they are here for the community.

Thank you from my family for the condolences and hope everyone has a great holiday :)

All of the staff were very professional and welcoming. The doctor was very nice and explained our treatment plan perfectly. Also were very patient with my very anxious pup which helped make the appointment go smoothly

Mission Valley Pet Clinic is the absolute best!  So grateful to have found this place.  They go above and beyond, and they are somehow more affordable than other clinics.  Dr. Herrera has been incredible in figuring out my dog’s chronic gut issues.  We made more progress with her in a matter of months than we did with other vets over the course of several years.  Everyone at this clinic truly cares about your pet and it shows!!
Pancake is extremely nervous at the vet, and they went out of their way to make her as comfortable as possible. We found our forever vet!
I felt very comfortable taking my fur baby to Mission Valley Pet Clinic. I felt everyone was very friendly and very caring

Everyone here is so friendly. I brought in my kitten Moscato, they treated him like their own. They even referred me to several affordable pet insurance for him. They really get to know each pet. They also have a free first checkup not including vaccines, which is VERY helpful with vet bills. It’s a professional and affordable vet clinic. I will continue to bring Moscato here as he is so comfortable with them already.

Very happy with the care provided by Mission Valley Pet Clinic.  The clinic staff are easy to deal with and very professional.  Dr. Herrera is thorough and very caring.  They provided good advice for the further care of our animals.  Would highly recommend their services!

I have been a regular customer with all of my animals for over 30 years.  The faces have changed, but the level of care and consideration remains very consistent.  Mission Valley Pet Clinic has a very dedicated and professional staff that truly care about my pets.
Thank you so much for sharing your great experience with us, Beth !

My experience at this veterinarian was outstanding. Couple of things that really appealed to me, first is they did not try to just tack on extra tests and what not yo drive up a higher bill like Banfield does. I feel like they used good, sensible approaches to treatment.

This was my first visit here and it will now be my new vet. Overall I am just really happy to not receive the kind of treatment you get from chain places that need to make money for the layers of management and shareholders. It's a smaller place but extremely well ran.

My vet in particular was super good with my dog, even if my dog was acting a little scared and hostile at times.

I am incredibly grateful for Mission Valley Pet Clinic!

When I was unexpectedly rushed to the hospital due to seizures, I needed a safe place nearby for my dog. Without hesitation, the staff quickly stepped in—making sure I received the care I needed while ensuring my sweet boy was safe and comfortable. Their professionalism and compassion were evident from the very beginning.

While I was in the ICU, they went above and beyond to coordinate with my parents, keeping Rocky’s routine consistent so he felt secure and free from anxiety. They provided constant updates, which gave me so much peace of mind during such a stressful time.

Especially in a true emergency, I could not be more thankful for the kindness, speed, and dedication of their team. I feel completely confident leaving Rocky in their care. He is happy, well-looked after, and I know he’s in the best hands possible.
Amazing staff and services but $90 for ear cytology is just insane price

This is my go to Vet in San Diego and it's worth the drive for me as the staff and doctors are amazing and very professional. I have twice been able to advance appointments to address urgent dog needs. Routine visits are also easy and professional and testing all done onsite to avoid multiple trips. Jessica is amazing, friendly and a problem solver and a true asset to the office.
Expensive but quality work, def making my primary vet
Your feedback is highly appreciated, Colleen. Thank you so much for the review!

My fur baby had her first flight this week. MVPC did a fantastic job getting us in and ready for travel in such a short notice. They took extra time & precautions in providing me with what I needed to keep her calm/relaxed for the rabies shot + 5 hour flight. Reliable staff, I recommend! 🐈😊

Recently moved here and started taking my dog to this vet and they seriously have the nicest staff out of any vet office I’ve been to. They are very accommodating and will take great care of your pup!
Our dog Sniffy LOVES you all. He actually enjoys coming to you.
Hi, Krlitx. We appreciate the rating. So glad we could provide you with a positive experience at Mission Valley Pet Clinic!
Brought my Bengal Sheeba for exam & bloodwork & vaccines and just love the whole staff - thank you❣️❣️
Hi, Alejandra. Great to hear that you had a good experience at Mission Valley Pet Clinic. We really appreciate you taking the time to share!
Great vet care for my dog!

Dr. Frank and her staff are amazing people! We are very blessed to have her as our lovely female cats Vet. Would recommend her to anyone
Greg & De De

Thank you Dr. Frank for the wonderful loving care you have provided for Avery. She's lucky to have a Veterinarian like you. Your staff you have chosen are very good people.  We thank you also for the care you will give her in the future. Greg & De De Main
Everyone is so friendly here and I trust that my pup is in the best hands!

Great veterinarian office with overnight boarding. Everyone is very friendly, and you can tell they really care about all their clients and their pets. I’ve boarded my Labrador retriever overnight several times and he loves being there because he gets lots of attention from the staff and gets to play with the other dogs throughout the day. Plus, if he was to have any medical issues while being boarded, then the veterinarians are right there and they know his entire health history. I highly recommend this place for all your pet’s needs!

We’ve been bringing our two cats and two dogs to Mission Valley Pet Clinic for nearly 10 years, and I honestly can’t say enough good things. The entire team is incredibly attentive and treats our pets as if they were their own.

We’ve worked with Dr. Herrera, Dr. Klinger, and Dr. Frank — all of whom are knowledgeable, compassionate, and take the time to explain exam results and treatment options thoroughly. I’ve never once felt pressured into unnecessary procedures or upsold on extras, which says a lot about their integrity.

They even went above and beyond during dental procedures and saved my dogs’ teeth for me at my request (yes, I’m obsessed with my animals 😆).

One of the things I love most is how easy they make communication. Being able to text the office to schedule appointments or even send a quick photo of a concern is such a relief. The front office staff and techs are always welcoming and helpful — special thanks to Melissa (RVT), Lily, Brianna, Josie, Jessica, and Erica for their kindness and professionalism.

Prices are extremely fair for the level of care provided. If you’re just looking for the cheapest option, this might not be the place — but the peace of mind knowing my furry ones are so well cared for is worth every penny. The follow-up care is also outstanding; I always appreciate the check-in calls after a visit to make sure my pets are doing well.

We’re so grateful to have such a wonderful team looking after our family.
Took our cat, Maple, here and the staff were super friendly and helpful. They were very sweet and caring with our kitty. Definitely coming here from now on for both our cats. Thank you so much!!!
Thank you so much for sharing your great experience with us, Raychelle !
This has been the best pet clinic I have found. Will continue her care here. Highly recommend.  The staff is great especially Diana. She provided great care.
All the techs and Vets are compassionaye, empathetic and professional. The BEST clinic in SD
Thank you for taking the time to rate us, Byron! We are delighted that you had a great experience with Mission Valley Pet Clinic .
Excellent

We love Dr. Herrera and all the staff at Mission Valley Pet Clinic. They are kind and empathetic, take time with my dog, giving him the time he needs to warm up and relax and takes time explaining everything to us. They make me feel like they truly love my dog and think he's the best. We feel blessed to have found such a wonderful vet for our pup.

We are  spending a month in San Diego and my dog Hashtag started struggling with allergies.  I needed to find a great Vet quickly and was able to get in here same day.  The team is excellent & quite kind and allergy issue taken care of.  I highly recommend this group!

Hate leaving my two rescues anywhere at all. They are sweet guys but not the best behaved. I could see how healthy and happy they were when I picked them up. Final note: The boarding facilities are clean. Other places I have boarded have a strong urine stench. Not Mission Valley Pet Clinic. Very happy with this place.

They care very deeply about the wellbeing of my pet and I have always had a great experience at Mission Valley Pet Clinic! When I was having an emergency with my cat they were the only ones who offered any advice to me when no one else would take me. Thank you for being my trusted vet clinic all these years!

I am deeply disappointed with the level of care and compassion my dog received at this clinic. When I brought him in, he was clearly in distress. He was walking in circles, unstable, and showing neurological signs that were linked to his pituitary gland issue, which this vet had previously diagnosed. Instead of addressing the urgent, obvious issue with his health, the vet insisted we go ahead with an expensive surgery to remove a foreign object from his stomach. This foreign object had been previously evaluated just four months earlier, and the vet had assured me it was not the main concern at that time and had no bearing on his pituitary gland issues.

It felt like the clinic was more focused on upselling an unnecessary surgery than on truly addressing the pressing problem. My dog was in clear pain, and it was upsetting to see that the vet did not seem to prioritize his well-being over financial gain. To make matters worse, the front desk staff was rude and dismissive when we questioned why this surgery was being so heavily pushed before even exploring the neurological symptoms he was exhibiting.

Thankfully, we found another vet who was incredibly compassionate and honest with us. They took the time to explain what was happening with my dog’s condition and how the issues he was facing were related to his pituitary gland. They showed such care when discussing our options and helped us make the difficult decision to lay our dog to rest after weeks of discomfort.

Had this initial clinic been more sensitive to our situation and more focused on my dog’s quality of life, he would not have suffered as much during his final days. I will never return to this office, and I would not recommend it to anyone who is seeking genuine care and empathy for their pets.

Recently adopted a 1 year old Belgian Malinois, I took her in to get her first check up. She is my first dog of my own, so I was new to the whole vet experience. Mission Valley Pet Clinic was patient with my puppy and made sure she was comfortable in the new environment. They gave her a vaccine and called me the next day to make sure my puppy was doing good! Their communication was amazing and they answered all my questions! Will definitely be going back for all her vet needs!

Kristi was so helpful and answered all my questions about being a new dog owner! My dog loved his visit even after getting vaccines and blood drawn, which speaks volumes about the care and attention from Kristi and the staff at Mission Valley Pet Clinic.

When we were paying at the counter today,  one of their vet techs brought out another dog on a loose leash and the dog immediately rushed my dog around the counter and the 2 of them started going at it in the blink of an eye.  Luckily the dad grabbed his dog and took her outside while the tech who brought her out just ran straight to the back.

Thankfully no one was bit, but the whole situation was stressful and completely preventable had the vet tech acted responsibly. It’s a small waiting area. Not all dogs are easy and friendly. Even the nicest of dogs may not get along together. They as the professionals should know this and exercise appropriate caution at all times to keep things as safe and smooth as possible.
Always compassionate care from staff and MD and assistants at Mission Valley Pet Clinic. We have been taking our pets here for 20 years. Wouldn’t go anywhere else. Thank you for your care!!!
Thank you so much for sharing your great experience with us, Phillip !

I want to thank Dr. Klinger and staff for seeing my pup on such short notice! We were visiting from the east coast and he was not doing well. The treatment plan made a huge difference and he’s feeling much better as a result.

Dr. Klinger also revealed something via tests that none of my vets back home have ever flagged before. This was extremely useful, as I believe it will help prevent future problems.

Overall, I’m really impressed by how friendly and attentive everyone is at MVPC. It is clear that this clinic truly cares about animals. Highly recommend and will be using them again if ever in need while visiting SD!
My handsome furboy was a hit at the clinic.  Dr. Herrera opened the door for the staff to see this sweet companion sitting on my lap.  They always take good care of him.
I love this clinic!  They are so caring for my labradoodle.  Very professional and nice!  I have recommended them to friends and will continue to do so!
The customer service was great. Dr. Herrera has been great with all of my cats!
Always great to work with! My 2 cats are 9 yrs old and need their experience and care.
very friendly, reasonably priced, and they followed up to make sure the treatment went well for my dog. will be going back every time whenever my dog has any issues
Thank you so much for sharing your great experience with us, David !
Your feedback is highly appreciated, Tricia. Thank you so much for the review!

Today was my first visit at Mission Valley Pet Clinic with my personal dog. The staff was very welcoming and met all of my and my dogs needs! The doctor that I saw was amazing and she was very generous answering all of my questions. The doctor and the staff made both me and my pet feel well taken care of. I highly recommend Mission Valley Pet Clinic!
Everyone is an absolute delight.

Súper friendly staff that was able to squeeze me in last minute. They did not pressure me into any unnecessary procedures, and still did a thorough job caring for my concerns and making sure my dog was as comfortable as possible.
One of my Cat Babies passed a few weeks ago, and they helped me handle his remains

Friendly,  knowledgeable doctors and staff. Always answer all my questions, give me options for Sadies treatment or explain what was done that day. Very happy I found Mission Valley Pet Clinic when we moved to this area. Plus other pet parents are friendly.....place has very friendly, relaxed atmosphere. Good vibes ....😊 …

I used to live in San Diego when I fist moved back from Japan, I decided to get a dog and needed to find a Vet that would love my dog as I do. Taking my dog to Mission Valley Pet Clinic was the best decision I ever made. Even after moving away for Menifee, I still go back because you can't beat the love and care they provide for our precious furry friends.
Recently I took 3 dogs at once, with no hesitation I was offered help to bring them in, and was given the most undivided attention, even more so knowing that one of my pets is in fact a service animal who helps me with daily issues. I should have never left but now I know I never will.

Mission Valley Pet Clinic has been our primary care vet for two of my dogs and also my brother's dog. All of the staff there from the reception desk, vet techs and all three vets that seen our dogs have been amazing - even when dealing with one of my extremely fearful/skittish dogs. I am happy that Mission Valley Pet Clinic is nearby and I can avoid the big box clinics.   Highly recommend them!
We have been with this outstanding team for more than twenty years. They’re compassionate and responsive.
Great Place! Good Doctors, friendly and helpfull staff. They always try so hard to accommodate even on short notice when you have a sick pet.
Our puppers actually look forward to going to the vet. The staff is so friendly and really listen to what is going on with the pups. If you're looking for a vet, don't hesitate!

I always have the best experience when taking my little guy Whiskers to Mission Valley Pet Clinic, everyone of the staff are friendly and professional and Whiskers loves being around them. The doctors take their time with him and he loves getting his treats at the end of his visit. I recommend MVPC to anyone looking for a great Pet Clinic.
Your feedback is highly appreciated, Chris. Thank you so much for the review!

I was referred to this clinic by a friend, i called the clinic Friday the 3rd of January and was told to leave a message they would get back to me, I called the following week and left a message again, no one would answer the phone. I called Tuesday to make an appt and the girl that answered and said if this is not an emergency to please hold when I told her I had been waiting since the Friday before, she put me on hold. Never got a chance to use them, but if this happened before I used them no telling the bad news I would have for you now. Don't waste your time. and if you look at the reviews, they only respond to the people that leave good reviews. which shows how little they care.

Attentive from making the appointment to being greeted upon arrival to robust exam/assessment and answering my questions by the Vet to taking care of the health issue.  Grateful that I can bring my fur baby to a caring and high quality clinic.
The staff and the care is always top notch!
Have taken our 2 cats and dog here for a couple years now, they have provided excellent care and are very attentive to all our pets needs! Definitely recommend if looking for a great vet practice
Great clinic that my family go to for years. From our passed dog to our current fur babies, they are great.

We had a positive experience at Mission Valley Pet Clinic for our cat and dog’s annual checkup. The appointment fee was $85 per pet (just for the appointment itself). The vet was professional, thorough, and took the time to explain everything clearly. Our pets seemed comfortable—our dog actually seemed to enjoy being there, though our cat was a little nervous.

The appointment started on time, and we didn’t experience any long waits. The only downside was parking—since we had an evening appointment, we found a spot, but it might be harder to find one if the clinic is busier. Arriving early is a good idea. We also appreciated the follow-up call the next morning to check on how our pets were feeling after their vaccinations.

Overall, we were very satisfied and would definitely recommend the clinic!
I just got a new kitten was a little bit distressed, but needed cute kitty check up. The vet and all of the staff couldn’t have been kinder. This is a great place.
